en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Sinan, from Abdul Malik Al Qummy who said,
‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘The one in Ihraam performs ablution, then he wipes his face with the towel concealing all of it’. Heasws said: ‘There is no problem’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Sinan from ‘Abd al-Malik al-Qummiy who has said the following:
“I once asked abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who takes wudu’ and then wipes his face with a handkerchief that covers all of it. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not harmful.’”
